scope: Single fastboot boot of entry-probe-09 (v16 kernel 6e1ba192, screen clear + dense ladder); user video; recovery closed

observed.stopped_before: cyan 352 (the band drawn right after msr sctlr_el1 + isb)
observed.green_EBS_breadcrumb: GONE - the clear wiped rows 0..1152 and the firmware bar lives in rows 0..199
observed.firmware_log_text: still present below, and the firmware redrew its menu afterwards

conclusion: The screen clear works, but it is harmful: it wiped the green EBS breadcrumb and the kernel only drew three bands, stopping before the MMU switch. The clear issues about 415000 sixteen-byte stores (6.6 MB) to the framebuffer before the MMU is on, which is the only pre-cyan change in v16; the silent stop with no panic band and no exception band fits a watchdog or timeout reset caused by that write burst, rather than a fault.
next_step: v17 = the same dense ladder without the clear. If the ladder alone restores the cyan and white bands, the clear was the cause; the green breadcrumb then survives as the EBS landmark. A clear of only the logo zone (rows 595..1035) can be tried later as a separate experiment.
not_proven: that the write burst is what stopped the kernel (inference, not measurement)
